title: Lokgram: The Learning Trail
description: A nine-checkpoint family treasure hunt through Lokgram, combining outdoor discovery with friendly puzzles.

settings.rules: Stay together on public paths. Do not enter the school or library unless it is open and the organizer has confirmed access. No running is required. Hints cost points and are shared by the team. Ask the organizer for help if GPS or a puzzle misbehaves.
settings.completionMessage: You completed the Lokgram Learning Trail. Show this screen to the organizer at the confirmed prize stop.

nodes.clue: Your first destination is a leafy outdoor space in Lokgram, with trees, open paths, shaded corners, and room to pause. It carries the name of a tropical summer favourite—the fruit known for golden flesh, a sweet fragrance, and a taste people wait for all year. Find this refreshing green retreat, then let the map confirm when you are nearby.
nodes.prompt: When you have arrived, tap “I’m here — check location”.

hints.title: A little nudge

content.text: Think of the fruit that many people wait for in summer.

nodes.text: Find all six library-related words in your grid. Your team receives one fixed variant; it will not change after refresh.
Books, pages, quiet corners, and curious minds point you toward the Satyamev Jayate Public Library area.

hints.title: Reveal one word

content.text: Start with the shortest word in your list and scan across each row.

nodes.clue: “Satyamev Jayate” means “Truth alone triumphs.” Work together and choose the fairest, most evidence-based response.
nodes.prompt: Answer any three questions correctly to continue. You may skip the others without losing points.

questions.prompt: What is the fairest way to choose one team representative?

options.label: Let everyone have an equal vote.
Let one person decide without asking.

questions.prompt: If you do not know whether a message is true, what should you do first?
What does it mean to listen respectfully?

options.label: Give someone attention even when you disagree.

questions.prompt: Which action helps keep a shared park pleasant?
If two teammates have different ideas, what is a good next step?

options.label: Discuss both ideas and agree together.

questions.prompt: Why should a team follow a clearly stated rule?

options.label: So the same standard is fair to everyone.
So the fastest team wins automatically.

questions.prompt: What should you do when you make a mistake in a team puzzle?

options.label: Say so and help the team correct it.

questions.prompt: Which is an example of civic responsibility?

options.label: A secret source nobody can inspect.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest team advantage in this hunt?

hints.title: A gentle nudge

content.text: Choose the answer that is fair, evidence-based, and considerate of others.

nodes.clue: I am full of chapters, tales, and facts, yet I am not a single book. I ask you to keep your voice down while you explore worlds without leaving your chair. You are looking for a place where pages turn, questions are welcome, and a neighbourhood can learn together.
nodes.prompt: When you are at the public approach, tap “I’m here — check location”.

hints.title: A location nudge

content.text: Use the broad map area and look for the public library reference in the event briefing.
